title: General English – Level 03
overview: This pre-intermediate English language course is designed to develop learners' communication skills in everyday, social and professional contexts. Through guided listening, speaking, reading and writing practice, participants build vocabulary, grammar accuracy and cultural awareness needed for effective interaction.
audience: Learners at the appropriate level seeking to improve their English language skills.
Professionals and residents who use English in daily life or the workplace.
Individuals preparing to progress to the next level of English study.
methodology: Communicative instructor-led lessons combining guided speaking, listening, reading and writing tasks; grammar practice; vocabulary building; role plays; authentic materials; formative feedback; and an end-of-course assessment.
competencies: Communicating effectively in English in everyday and professional contexts.
Understanding spoken and written English at the appropriate level.
Using grammar and vocabulary accurately and appropriately.
Reading and writing English texts for practical purposes.
Applying culturally appropriate language and etiquette.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Use English effectively in a range of everyday and professional situations.
Understand spoken and written English at the appropriate level.
Apply key grammar structures and vocabulary with increasing accuracy.
Read and produce practical texts in English.
Demonstrate cultural awareness in English-speaking contexts.
